mechanics.title: Hit targeting through non-solid blocks
mechanics.description: The melee target ray ignores blocks without a collision shape, so swings hit the mob instead of the grass or similar block in front of it.

getting_started: Nothing to configure; just attack mobs standing in grass.
editor_notes: Modrinth lists it as client-required, server unsupported. Needs Puzzles Lib and Forge Config API Port.
name: Cut Through
summary: Attacks pass through blocks with no collision shape, such as tall grass, so you can hit mobs behind them without breaking the plant.
